vision: 7x7 wrapped square about head; walls do not occlude tile vision; portal destination is never visible through portal
startup: MAP W H, UNIT_LIMIT; round header UNIT_COUNT known; symmetry type not given
sharedVisionCaveat: union across allies is an upper bound. Sonar is a ray stopped by first kelp/body, no sender/team identity, no all-to-all guarantee; newly split child has separate memory. Survey bounds ignore temporary bodies.

area.reliability: exact W*H, map size is in init

wrap.reliability: guaranteed topology; boundary may contain kelp or portals

initialHeads.reliability: exact own UNIT_COUNT if captured at game r0; init of child/restart is not game r0

initialMass.reliability: only own length exact; total needs all starting roots' pre-action reports, not current total after splits; incomplete sonar must carry a coverage fraction

passableTileShare.reliability: kelp is an edge, not a blocked tile. Report mobile tiles and reachable component fraction separately. Unseen graph completion gives intervals, not a point

kelpDensity.reliability: exact on observed distinct edges; unseen map extrapolation biased by path selection; empirical early mean/error in tables

spawnTiles.reliability: countdown>=0 identifies spawner even without pearl. Unique coordinates in own/shared seen set exact. Total is lower bound; symmetry only expands after topology/support contradictions resolved

spawnRate.earliestRound: 10-30 for repeated fast resets; rare tiles later or never by r500
spawnRate.reliability: countdown reset is an attempt even if pearl/body blocks it; collect elapsed exposure and reset draws by symmetry orbit, do not double count shared draws. Replay lacks these countdowns, so empirical reset-rate validation N=0. Successful natural appearance proxy is not an attempt-rate estimate

fountainShare.earliestRound: 10-30 locally after >=4 resets as proposed confidence gate; whole-map later
fountainShare.reliability: definition mean gap<=12; min/max hidden. Four resets is a proposal, not a verified precision guarantee. Continuous monitoring is needed to avoid truncated interval bias. Unknown remains unknown; one low countdown is not a fountain certificate

pocketCount.earliestRound: 10-30 for entirely seen small pocket; long/deep regions later
pocketCount.reliability: a local dead end is certified only when all incident edges and unique mouth into a known cycle are seen; absence of seen cycle can be an exploration frontier. Full 2-core fraction not early identifiable

corridorWidth.reliability: local degree-2 share is a proxy, not geometric width. startVertexCut is count of independent routes between starting bodies, not physical corridor width; full min-cut requires surveyed graph and portal pairs

startDistance.earliestRound: 0 torus lower bound if starting symmetry resolved; 10-30 route interval; up to full survey
startDistance.reliability: opponent starting bodies need vision or resolved symmetry of own complete starting bodies. Optimistic unknown-edge graph gives lower bound; observed confirmed path gives upper bound; unseen portal partner can invalidate ordinary-distance bounds and must remain unconstrained

isolated.earliestRound: 10-30 only if entire component frontier incl portal mates certified; otherwise unresolved
isolated.reliability: no enemy seen is not isolation. Portals-like conclusion requires even optimistic graph has no path, including all paired portals

centreSpawnShare.earliestRound: 10-30 conditional on symmetry, initial body reports and distance bounds; global later
centreSpawnShare.reliability: middle is distance ratio f in [.4,.6), not board coordinate centre. Classify tile only if interval remains in same frontier band; spawner coordinates alone do not provide middle fraction

centreCapacityShare.reliability: also needs reliable reset-rate estimates. Full-map fitted relationship is not automatically a r30 policy; early oracle rates never supplied as runtime input

edgeSpawnShare.reliability: defined coordinate distance<3 to any boundary; measurable on observed spawners, but wrap means coordinate edge is not safe territory

kingSafety.earliestRound: whenever king elected and ingress mapped
kingSafety.reliability: shortest static legal distance ignores temporary bodies and enemy sprint budgets. Unknown enemies remain possible outside vision; use recent scouts/guard reports and route certificates, not empty global replay

symmetry: Maintain vertical, horizontal, rotational candidates; compare overlapping observed tile spawn status AND transformed edge types/portal equivalence before adopting geometry. The primary early audit uses spawn-support contradictions only; its expanded coverage concerns spawn status, not proven full topology.
unseenPortalCaveat: A partial graph with unknown portal endpoints cannot give a valid finite lower bound by simply closing the portal. The static scout distance interval uses full paired-edge graph as a generous feasibility reference, so it is not a deployable isolation certificate.
